description: 大屯火山地區溫泉採樣分析點位資料 [volcanoes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 經濟部中央地質調查所自2004年以來於大屯火山地區進行溫泉採樣分析之點位資料，溫泉為火山活動徵兆觀測項目之一，藉由溫泉水質分析可協助研判火山活動情形。. Coverage: Datun Volcanic Area. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
